saved_payment_method.description: Object containing information about the saved payment method used to pay for the order.

initiator.description:
Indicates who is allowed to initiate the payment. 

:::note
Using this endpoint, only merchant initiated payments are supported with Revolut Pay.
:::

type.description: Type of environment where the payment was made.

time_zone_utc_offset.description: Defines the offset to UTC in minutes.

screen_width.description: The browser's screen width in pixels.

screen_height.description: The browser's screen height in pixels.

java_enabled.description: Indicates if the browser has Java enabled.

challenge_window_width.description: Defines the width of the pop-up window where the authentication challenge appears.

browser_url.description: The URL of the page where the payment was initiated.

Environment.description:
Environment object, indicating in which environment the payment was made.

:::warning
Only required if `initiator: customer`.
:::

:::note
Only `browser` is available at the moment.
:::
